description: Lifecycle policy for RedCap legacy assets, archaeology records, and ignored runtime evidence.

assets.authority: .dev-task.md is the current task truth source; stale completed notes must be corrected, not archived silently.
docs catalog is the first-read index for historical docs; it prevents bulk-reading task reports and specs.
task reports are historical evidence; use catalog summaries and exact reads instead of default full-history loading.
spec authority, lifecycle status, and supersession must be tracked in the registry before specs move or retire.
formal evidence and referenced named local evidence are preserved; acceptance fixtures or unreferenced named local evidence may be pruned only when prism-runs-lifecycle classifies them safe.
hot lessons stay active; cold or superseded lessons move only when the knowledge index preserves archaeology.
redcap-knowledge is the private cold archive for reports and research; it must be exact-read and index-routed, not default-loaded or exported raw.
templates/shared-knowledge is only the safe template source for redcap-arsenal; public entries require RedCap Forge processing before append.
RedCap Forge is the concrete distillation pipeline between private artifacts and public arsenal entries; it prevents raw report or identity leakage.
This policy is the product-level map for report, knowledge, runtime evidence, Forge and arsenal boundaries before CLI release.
workflow/runtime directories are local state, not tracked historical truth; never bulk-read them for archaeology.

prism_runs_policy.evidence_bound_rule: If a run id is referenced by tracked reports, knowledge assets, or task reports, local_prune_candidate must remain false even after the local retention threshold.
